title: Instantiation of Human Values in Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We address this gap by introducing a framework, grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values, for studying value instantiation: the process by which ideals such as success, care, or freedom are visually realized. Using person-centered prompts from 70 positive and negative value items, we generate 28,000 images across four state-of-the-art T2I models. We identify visual prototypes, recurring combinations of subjects, actions, and settings, and use them to quantify how narrowly models instantiate these values and how this breadth compares with human descriptions of the same items. translated_title: 图像生成中人类价值的具象化
translated_abstract: 文生图（T2I）模型日益融入日常视觉文化，然而人们对其如何将抽象的人类价值转化为视觉场景却知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们引入了一个基于施瓦茨（Schwartz）基本人类价值理论的框架，用于研究“价值具象化”（value instantiation）：即成功、关爱或自由等理想在视觉上得以实现的过程。我们使用来自70个正向与负向价值条目的以人物为中心的提示词，在四个最先进的文生图模型上生成了28,000张图像。我们识别出视觉原型——即反复出现的主体、动作与场景的组合——并用它们来量化模型具象化这些价值的范围有多狭窄，以及这种广度与人类对相同条目的描述相比有何差异。随后，我们将这些原型映射到一个涵盖场景设定、社交性、参与方式和社会语调的社会构型分类体系上，揭示出哪些内容被模型系统性地突显或忽视。
tldr: 该研究基于施瓦茨人类价值理论构建分析框架，通过28,000张生成图像揭示四个主流文生图模型如何将成功、关爱、自由等抽象价值狭窄地具象化为重复出现的视觉原型，并将其映射到社会构型分类体系以揭示模型系统性的价值呈现偏向。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a framework grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values, analyzing 28,000 images from four state-of-the-art T2I models to reveal how they narrowly instantiate abstract values like success, care, and freedom into recurring visual prototypes, which are mapped onto a taxonomy of social configurations to expose systematic biases in value representation.
